transitions.operation_detail: Single-cell lysis releases naked double-stranded genomic DNA, which is digested in the same tube with MspI at C^CGG leaving 5'-CG overhangs; the enzyme is then heat-inactivated
The 5'-CG overhangs are filled in and a single 3'-dA is added to the blunted ends with Klenow fragment (exo-) and a dATP-rich dNTP mix; the enzyme is heat-inactivated in the same tube

Premethylated indexed Y-shaped Illumina TruSeq adapters are ligated to both dA-tailed ends through the adapter 3'-T overhang with highly concentrated T4 DNA ligase; the ligase is then heat-inactivated

Bisulfite conversion (MethylCode): 98 C for 10 min then 64 C for 2.5 h. The 98 C step denatures the duplex - all earlier incubations are capped at 80 C specifically to avoid denaturation - and unmethylated cytosines are deaminated to uracil independently on each strand, so the two converted molecules are no longer complementary and are carried forward as two separate single-stranded species.

PCR enrichment with the Illumina P5 (QP1) and P7 (QP2) primers: in the first cycle only the P7-side primer can anneal, and from the second cycle onward both strands are amplified with uracil copied as thymine, completing the double-stranded indexed library Amplification is performed as two sequential rounds with the same QP1/QP2 primers: round 1 uses uracil-tolerant PfuTurbo Cx hot-start polymerase (25 cycles, 300 nM primers) so methylated and unmethylated fragments amplify comparably; round 2 uses Phusion HF master mix (22 cycles, 500 nM primers). Gel-based size selection of 200-500 bp fragments, cleanups and QC are folded into this transition.
